test_title: PYST 15 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect voice.

The student said, "I have been reading this book for a month, but I still do not understand the last chapter, which is the most crucial part."

options.text: The student said that he had been reading that book for a month, but he still did not understand the last chapter, which was the most crucial part.
The student said that he has been reading this bookfor a month, but he still does not understand the last chapter, which is the most crucial part.
The student said that he had been reading this book for a month, but he still did not understand the last chapter, which was the most crucial part.
The student said that he had been reading that book for a month, but he still does not understand the last chapter, which is the most crucial part.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Direct Speech:** The student said, "I have been reading this book for a month, but I still do not understand the last chapter, which is the most crucial part."
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"have been reading" becomes "had been reading"**
 
 
• Since the reporting verb "said" is in the past tense, the **Present Perfect Continuous** tense ("have been reading") changes to the **Past Perfect Continuous** tense ("had been reading").
 
 
 
• **"this book" becomes "that book"**
 
 
• In indirect speech, words expressing nearness in time or place change to words expressing distance. "This" becomes **"that."**
 
 
 
• **"do not understand" becomes "did not understand"**
 
 
• The **Simple Present** tense ("do not understand") changes to the **Simple Past** tense ("did not understand").
 
 
 
• **"which is" becomes "which was"**
 
 
• Similarly, the **Simple Present** verb "is" changes to the **Simple Past** verb "was."
 
 
 
• **"I" becomes "he"**
 
 
• The first-person pronoun "I" changes to the third-person pronoun "he" to match the subject (the student).
 
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *The student said that he had been reading that book for a month, but he still did not understand the last chapter, which was the most crucial part.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "...he has been reading this book... does not understand... which is..." 

 
 
• Incorrect because it fails to change the present tenses to past tenses and fails to change "this" to "that."
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "...reading this book..." 
 
 
• Incorrect solely because it retains the word "this" instead of changing it to "that."
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "...does not understand the last chapter, which is..." 
 
 
• Incorrect because while it fixes the first half of the sentence, it fails to backshift the verbs in the second half ("does not understand" and "is" should be in the past tense).
